backlogged.summary: The diff against the base is empty, because the approval commit says the criteria already pass on v2. The verdict rests on the deterministic verify results: AC-1, AC-2 and AC-3 all passed. I did not re-run the checks myself, since this session is in plan mode.

For AC-1 and AC-3, verify warned that the check failed while running concurrently and passed when re-run alone. These checks run `node test/stress.mjs 3`, which already starts three concurrent suites, so they put heavy load on a machine that is also running other checks at the same time. Setting verify.check_parallel to 1 for this feature would avoid false failures.
